basis: Static reachability analysis of the published policy executor and profile contracts, not accuracy from this evaluation.
design_decision: Cover all ten semantically reachable directed nonself action transitions with six contexts each and certify the two impossible HOLD/DEMOTE directions.
known_prior_results: Earlier hosted policy-switch routes were already known to be resource-confounded and excluded. An unrelated local SLSA run was active. Neither supplied an edge, label, prompt, or outcome to this graph construction.
